tasks.short: Document rehabilitation findings, plans and outcomes

steps.what: Select findings and dictate examination results, treatment decisions and outcomes
Document the dictated findings in the clinical note template

loop.purpose: Draft a clinical note from explicit physician dictation
loop.input: Source dictation with patient identity, findings, decisions, outcomes and uncertainty
loop.output: Structured narrative draft with unsupported fields left blank
loop.check: Physician compares clinical meaning, negation, laterality, treatment choices and outcome descriptions with source dictation and record
loop.stop: One draft; uncertain identity or unsupported clinical statements return to manual note entry
loop.why_not_simpler: Native dictation should be tested first; placing varied free-text clinical observations into narrative sections may require a bounded loop

steps.what: Check the final note and file the exact clinical version

tasks.design: Keep selection and dictation of clinical facts with the physician, then draft into the clinical record system {OTHER}. The physician checks the complete meaning and signs the exact note; the draft does not choose treatment or infer unspoken findings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rehabilitation notes combine varied findings, functional goals and narrative outcomes.
tasks.enabler_now: Clinical dictation and bounded note drafting can reduce repetitive narrative entry.
tasks.still_hard: Negation, laterality and the difference between a goal and an achieved outcome must remain clear.
tasks.human_edge: The physician decides which findings matter and whether the note accurately represents the encounter.
tasks.altitude: Less note assembly, with clinical assessment and record accountability unchanged.

reach.task: Resolve note provenance and correction queries

evidence.claim: Autoscriber records consultations, produces a draft and lets the clinician validate before clinical-record filing; this establishes drafting capability, not rehabilitation-specific savings.
The proposed dictated-note workflow and time scenario are E1 model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is documentation after examination and treatment decisions; those clinical activities are separate and unchanged.

The physician produces patient/encounter IDs, source date, finding text, laterality, treatment decisions, outcome status and uncertainty in s1. Capture retains all 40 hours; missing identity or unclear source returns to manual entry. No structured finding extraction is free.
Test native dictation and templates before a custom loop. No ambient recording or new patient-data collector is required by this design.
Allow five focal hours for template upkeep and failure review beyond routine note checking.
research_questions: Does checking drafted notes preserve functional and outcome meaning while reducing net documentation time?

already_counted.description: Source dictation and final clinical note check

approvals.approved_version: Exact clinical note, patient/encounter IDs and source dictation version; edits require another physician check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R82.5 gross17.5 minus5 upkeep =12.5 net. High assumes manual narrative assembly; low covers effective existing dictation or extensive corrections. Assessment and treatment time are excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assess rehabilitation goals, abilities and multidisciplinary treatment needs
Develop immediate and long-term rehabilitation plans with patients and the team

tasks.design: Keep multidisciplinary goal setting and treatment selection with the physician, patient and team. The clinical record system {OTHER} holds the resulting plan through the separate documentation task; this task claims no second saving for formatting it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans must balance clinical needs, patient goals and practical support.
tasks.enabler_now: Text generation does not establish appropriate individual treatment selection.
tasks.still_hard: Goals, tolerance and family or community support can change over time.
tasks.human_edge: The physician integrates specialist input and negotiates a feasible plan with the patient.
tasks.altitude: Planning authority and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify participation goals for coordinated planning

evidence.claim: Keeping comprehensive treatment planning human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge; the digest supplies no validated automated rehabilitation planner.

assumptions: Boundary is physician assessment and agreement of the plan, not the therapy team's whole workload or subsequent note production.
No free structured functional profile, contraindication flag or automated programme selection is assumed.
No custom planning tool is proposed; use existing clinical references.
Zero upkeep because this task does not change.
research_questions: Which decisions need negotiation across clinical goals and practical support?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Clinical planning remains human; document assembly is owned only by the separate documentation task.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess pain with standard clinical measures

steps.what: Assess pain intensity, location and duration using appropriate standardized measures

tasks.design: Retain administration and interpretation of pain measures with the clinician. Existing measure guidance in {DOCS} supports consistency; a numerical score does not replace the patient's account or clinical interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The same score can reflect different experiences and clinical contexts.
tasks.enabler_now: A digital scale does not establish less clinical assessment time.
tasks.still_hard: Communication barriers, variable symptoms and measure limitations need attention.
tasks.human_edge: The physician interprets the account without treating a score as a diagnosis.
tasks.altitude: Pain assessment responsibility and time remain unchanged.

reach.task: Clarify changes in the patient's reported pain

evidence.claim: Keeping pain assessment human is an E1 assessment from model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is clinical assessment, excluding separate note entry.
No automatic pain inference or free structured symptom profile is assumed.
Existing standard measures remain; no custom assessment tool is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no workflow changes.
unknowns: Measures used and patient communication needs
research_questions: Which limitations of the chosen measure affect interpretation for this patient group?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Clinical measurement and interpretation retain time; no hypothetical scoring arithmetic is added.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review pain response, function and adverse effects after interventions
Monitor effectiveness and decide whether further clinical review is needed

tasks.design: Keep review of effectiveness and adverse effects with the physician. Existing clinical history in {OTHER}, the clinical record system, supports review; no automatic treatment change is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Apparent symptom change may not establish treatment benefit.
tasks.enabler_now: Record availability helps context without replacing clinical review.
tasks.still_hard: Function, adverse effects and changing conditions complicate causal interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The physician recognises when a response warrants reassessment rather than routine continuation.
tasks.altitude: Monitoring and follow-up decisions remain unchanged.

reach.task: Compare functional change with symptom response
reach.learn: Shared outcome descriptions and clinical handoff

evidence.claim: Retaining intervention-effectiveness review is an E1 assessment from model knowledge, with no measured automation claim.

assumptions: Boundary is response review and judgement, not performing interventions or documenting the encounter.
No automatic effectiveness label or structured adverse-event flag is presumed.
Existing clinical tools remain; no custom decision engine is proposed.
Zero upkeep because no process changes.
research_questions: Which symptom and functional changes need direct reassessment?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gross0 net0. Patient review and clinical judgement retain all time; note-writing savings are not repeated here.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce clinical note assembly where feasible and protect time for multidisciplinary planning and patient assessment.
reach: Clarify participation goals with occupational therapy
Help records staff trace clinical note corrections
role.ambitious_version: A rehabilitation physician who maintains accurate records while keeping patient goals and clinical response central to decisions.
